description: Isobar mass difference test for prop:flavor-split-substrate

data.interpretation: Substrate prop:flavor-split-substrate provides the quark-swap contribution -ΔZ · Δm to isobaric mass differences.  The remaining contribution is the binding-energy difference, which depends on Coulomb + nuclear-symmetry + pairing energies — a separate substrate-derivation problem (open R&D, PR #679 territory).  Consistency of the decomposition for ³H ↔ ³He verifies the methodology.
data.extension_to_lithium: ⁶Li, ⁷Li have no stable isobar pair in the framework's current low-A atom set.  Once tr_M for H_{18}/H_{21} is available (deferred per atomic_mass_via_rho_k.py), the ⁶He/⁶Li/⁶Be triplet becomes the next testbed.
